questions.q: Why build your own Betaflight firmware?
options: Flash is limited: only what you need
To make the firmware run the PID loop faster
No reason, there's a ready-made one
questions.explain: Cloud Build builds for your list of options.

options: The drone's name in the OSD
A USE_* flag outside the lists
A CLI parameter with a user-defined name
questions.explain: An option outside the standard lists, a USE_* flag without the prefix; it isn't tested on every board, and its pin is set with resource.

questions.q: Where can you see the build key on the board?
options: The build_info command in the CLI

questions.explain: ./waf configure --board X; ./waf copter. The target is described in the board's hwdef.dat.

questions.q: What do you lose by removing GPS from the ArduPilot firmware?
options: Only the OSD elements with coordinates and speed
questions.explain: At all, not just for now. It's a sensible decision if you understand the consequences.

questions.q: Can you paste a diff all from another major version into your custom build?
options: Only in dump format and only on F7 boards
No, same as for the standard one
Yes, if the build has the same target
questions.explain: A custom build + a config from another version = unpredictability.

questions.q: What should you check right after flashing your custom build?
options: That version and BUILD KEY match, the gyro and the ports
Nothing: the build is guaranteed to be correct
questions.explain: Compare the build with the expected one and re-read what's critical: gyro, ports, receiver.

questions.q: How should you name your build so it can be reproduced?
options: With the date and commit hash
questions.explain: The date and commit hash unambiguously identify what it was built from.
